paper.title: SEAgent: Self-Evolving Computer Use Agent with Autonomous Learning from Experience
paper.central_claim: SEAgent lets a computer-use agent self-evolve on unfamiliar software via an automatically generated curriculum, a fine-tuned World State Model reward and RL (GRPO + adversarial imitation) on actor weights, raising OSWorld five-app success from 11.3% to 34.5%.

provenance.notes: Opus aggregate seat via the configured claude-kimi type fable; no route probing. actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref are null because the subagent runtime exposes no verifiable provider receipt to this worker.

sections_read: Opus: complete pinned text read end-to-end (abstract, all sections, tables, appendices) before opening seat records; targeted re-reads for every disputed field

evidence.quote: In each phase, these tasks are executed and step-wise evaluated. The resulting judgments and descriptions of the exploration trajectories are fed into the Curriculum Generator
evidence.support_explanation: 执行反馈进入课程生成器；同段随后的guidebook更新与下一阶段生成构成非权重闭环。

evidence.quote: acts as the system’s long-term memory, driving the Curriculum Generator to propose increasingly sophisticated and unexplored tasks in subsequent rounds, thereby guiding the agent toward mastery.
evidence.support_explanation: guidebook被留存，后续由任务生成器读取而非直接证明执行器记忆收益。

evidence.quote: All results are averaged over three runs.
evidence.support_explanation: 报告重复次数，不报告跨运行spread。

evidence.quote: from 11.3% to 34.5%. Furthermore, SEAgent with the specialist-to-generalist strategy (34.5%) outperforms both specialist RL (32.2%) and generalist RL (30.6%) by a substantial margin, demonstrating the effectiveness of the specialist-to-generalist paradigm.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者报告的主结果；不等同guidebook贡献或本席复现。

evidence.quote: The tasks generated by each strategy were used to train an RL agent (using GRPO only), with reward signals uniformly provided by our fine-tuned WSM.
evidence.support_explanation: 课程替代策略比较有共同RL/WSM，但没有独立guidebook-off控制。

evidence.quote: In contrast, our guidebook-based method, while having a lower initial data generation efficiency, excels at systematic exploration.
evidence.support_explanation: VSCode并非一致优于NNetNav；Celestia结果支持限定的新软件探索收益，不证明通用最优。

evidence.quote: Firstly, our self evolving agent system is bounded by GUI-Judge to provide reliable reward signal instead of real signal from environment.
evidence.support_explanation: 训练奖励是模型代理，作者承认可靠性边界。

evidence.quote: Only samples where the judgment matched the ground truth from OSWorld evaluation protocols were retained, resulting in 860 high-quality annotated trajectories.
evidence.support_explanation: WSM教师数据有规则锚；不是完全零外部监督。训练Chrome，跨软件与AgentRewardBench验证。

evidence.quote: Training is conducted for 1k iterations on 8 NVIDIA A100 80GB GPUs,
evidence.support_explanation: 每阶段训练资源可见；三阶段及五specialist+SFT+generalist增加成本，没有端到端GPU时/教师调用总账。

evidence.quote: However, providing too many descriptions (e.g., 200) creates an overly long context for the LLM, which degrades the quality of task generation and hurts final performance.
evidence.support_explanation: 存储/输入增长有明确失败边界，但无长期合并删除回退协议。

evidence.quote: Based on the observed evolution curves, we set the number of training phases to three, as performance gains saturate beyond that point.
evidence.support_explanation: 阶段数使用观察曲线选择；独立冻结选择/评测视图及去重审计不足。

evidence.quote: and rule-based evaluation is used as ground-truth supervision. We then compute the confusion matrix by comparing the predictions of different reward models against these labels.
evidence.support_explanation: WSM评测基于339 feasible OSWorld任务与规则标签，测量有锚，不能由训练代理误差直接否定最终SR指标。

evidence.quote: The agent’s policy is updated through experiential learning, comprised of adversarial imitation of failure actions and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on successful ones.
evidence.support_explanation: The improved object is the actor policy (weights) trained by RL.

evidence.quote: Our approach achieves a significant improvement of 23.2% in success rate, from 11.3% to 34.5%, over a competitive open-source CUA,
evidence.support_explanation: Headline result is the success rate of the weight-updated actor.

evidence.quote: It also maintains and updates a software guidebook
evidence.support_explanation: The only non-weight retained component is the guidebook text memory used by the task generator.

evidence.quote: A total of 3.5K successful trajectories, along with their corresponding reasoning traces, are distilled into a new base model (UI-TARS-7B
evidence.support_explanation: Generalist is produced by weight distillation (SFT) followed by RL, i.e. the retained product is weights.

evidence.quote: In the next RL phase, the agent samples from this updated, more challenging task buffer.
evidence.support_explanation: The guidebook's downstream use is the task buffer that feeds the next RL phase on actor weights.

evidence.quote: The tasks generated by each strategy were used to train an RL agent (using GRPO only), with reward signals uniformly provided by our fine-tuned WSM.
evidence.support_explanation: The only guidebook-related comparison (Table 4) is measured through a GRPO-trained actor; it compares whole task-generation strategies, not guidebook-on/off.

evidence.quote: These specialists are then distilled into a single generalist model through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on synthesized successful trajectories.
evidence.support_explanation: Headline 34.5% is a distilled-then-RL generalist checkpoint: product is weights.

evidence.quote: In this work, we explore the next phase of computer use agents, where a pretrained agent is fine-tuned to learn from its own experience
evidence.support_explanation: Authors position the contribution as fine-tuning from experience, contrasted with training-free methods.

evidence.quote: Based on the observed evolution curves, we set the number of training phases to three, as performance gains saturate beyond that point.
evidence.support_explanation: Informational: phase count chosen from evaluation curves (sol local-2).

signatures.object: CUA actor policy weights (UI-TARS-7B-DPO); auxiliary: task-generator guidebook text
signatures.information: Screenshots/actions; World State Model step labels a_T/a_F; guidebook U_p and captions C_p given only to the task generator
signatures.operation: Run curriculum tasks -> WSM labels steps -> GRPO on a_T + adversarial-imitation loss on a_F -> next phase; generator rewrites guidebook and task set
signatures.output: Updated actor weights pi_{p+1}; new task set I_{p+1}; updated guidebook U_{p+1}
signatures.conditions: WSM judgments are the only reward (no environment reward); 3 phases, 1k iterations each on 8xA100
signatures.selection_rule: Step labels from WSM; no candidate acceptance/rejection of harness edits
signatures.persistence: Weights checkpoint per phase; guidebook text per phase
signatures.failure_boundary: Bounded by WSM reliability; tasks <20 steps (authors' limitation)

gap.author_gap: CUAs depend on human-labelled data and fail on novel software.

claims.text: Competitive deep RL performance with52–98% lower training time and fewer interactions.
claims.setting: Pong/Breakout/SpaceInvaders, OCAtari object state, frame skip4,sticky_action0;20 configured optimization iterations; Sonnet20241022 backend.
claims.baseline_control: CleanRL/public DQN and PPO logs;8parallel baseline vs1agent; human reference.
claims.selection_vs_test: Best code/score within optimization; same full-game reward informs optimizer; no held-back final evaluation protocol.
claims.result_denominator: Table2: agent21/353/1200 at43m/91m/36m; DQN20/302/1383 at606m/1614m/1612m; PPO19/443/939 at144m/188m/339m. PPO beats agent Breakout; DQN and human beat SpaceInvaders. No episode averaging count or CI. Table3 action summary omits combined FIRE+MOVE while AppendixF combine_actions returns4/5, an interface documentation ambiguity.
counterevidence: Different observations/human priors/hardware and stop rules prevent strict efficiency attribution. Efficient32-env Breakout~450in33m disclosed. No full short+long rollout interaction count, token/dollar cost.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Author-reported useful scores and selected-baseline wall-clock savings on three configured games; no general or equal-information/equal-budget RL superiority.

claims.text: Full-game staged feedback overcomes long-horizon sparse-reward plateau.
claims.setting: Pong short rollout400 vs long evaluation~4000; staged thresholds19/0; Breakout/Invaders separate hand-written reward bins.
claims.baseline_control: Pong rollout-only vs rollout+full-game staged feedback
claims.selection_vs_test: Feedback and score drawn from same optimization process; best/max results.
claims.result_denominator: Table5 max7 vs21; no runs/seeds/uncertainty or2×2 staging/horizon decomposition.
counterevidence: Additional long evaluation consumes extra interactions; it and semantic staging co-vary. No graph-off/one-shot/random local edit code baseline.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Bundled long-game staged feedback helps this Pong setup; neither staging alone nor graph credit isolated.

claims.text: LLM infers game physics and yields interpretable/verifiable adaptable policies.
claims.setting: One omitted wall constant example plus initial/learned program appendix.
claims.baseline_control: Human partially specified docstring/scaffold; no physics-task baseline or formal verification.
claims.selection_vs_test: Selected illustrative bounce and learned source; no unseen physical conditions.
claims.result_denominator: AppendixD bounce x152→146,dx+6→−6; LOC Pong49→131,Breakout95→125,Invaders117→146; cyclomatic complexity grows to16/24/28.
counterevidence: Extensive game-specific docstrings/strategies already supplied; code growth does not certify interpretability/safety; no perturbation/transfer test or formal invariant proof.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Readable code and an illustrative inferred boundary; broad causal-reasoning/generalization/formal-verification claim untested.
